001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * FreeStyle Libre 2 CGM session start.
009 */
010@HistoryLogProps(
011    opCode = 404,
012    displayName = "CGM Start Session FSL2",
013    internalName = "LID_CGM_START_SESSION_FSL2"
014)
015public class CgmStartSessionFsl2HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
016
017    private long sessionStartTime;
018    private int sessionDuration;
019
020    public CgmStartSessionFsl2HistoryLog() {}
021    public CgmStartSessionFsl2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
022        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0);
023    }
024
025    public CgmStartSessionFsl2HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long sessionStartTime, int sessionDuration) {
026        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
027        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, sessionStartTime, sessionDuration);
028        parse(cargo);
029    }
030
031    public int typeId() {
032        return 404;
033    }
034
035    /**
036     * <table border="1">
037     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmStartSessionFsl2HistoryLog:</caption>
038     * <tr><td><code>sessionStartTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
039     * <tr><td><code>sessionDuration</code></td><td><code>raw[14] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
040     * </table>
041     */
042    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
043        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
044        this.cargo = raw;
045        parseBase(raw);
046        this.sessionStartTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
047        this.sessionDuration = raw[14] & 0xFF;
048    }
049
050    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
051        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0);
052    }
053
054    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long sessionStartTime, int sessionDuration) {
055        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
056            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(404, 0),
057            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
058            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
059            Bytes.toUint32(sessionStartTime),
060            new byte[]{(byte) sessionDuration}));
061    }
062
063    /**
064     * @return session start time, in seconds since the Tandem epoch
065     */
066    public long getSessionStartTime() {
067        return sessionStartTime;
068    }
069    /**
070     * @return session duration, in days
071     */
072    public int getSessionDuration() {
073        return sessionDuration;
074    }
075}
